campaign_surface.current_cli: The five-turn stabilization beginner flow is text-first and has no playback surface; its written choices, trade-offs, and uncertainty remain complete.
campaign_surface.live_gui: The current live GUI exposes the shared campaign-coverage panel and honors optional host-sourced stabilization audio metadata through the existing catalog.
campaign_surface.optional_audio_rule: Audio may reinforce only supplied visible state; mute, unavailable, reduced, or unsupported audio preserves the same written meaning.

open_work: human comprehension, educational usability, and fatigue review
limits: The mapping reuses current visible categories and catalog IDs; it does not infer hidden severity, intent, probability, causality, or future outcome.
Host-sourced music states and event cues remain optional visible-only channels; explicit empty cue metadata suppresses legacy fallback without changing written meaning.
No new cue, music state, audio file, route, transition, asset, screenshot, persistence, or registry entry is created or promoted.
Existing technical audio, accessibility, and provenance checks do not establish audio quality, human comprehension, educational usability, or fatigue-free use.
No instructor-only true-state view, counterfactual, distributional visualization, or public-release claim is made.
